meaning: The thumb — cooperation, teamwork, and being indispensable to the whole
note: From “Yensiane kokuromotie ho mmo po”: we do not bypass the thumb to tie a knot. Try it once and the point makes itself.
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
